levels.title: LEVEL 01: Mission Architect
levels.subtitle: Mission Profile & Trajectory Foundations
levels.description: Establish the foundational parameters of your Mars expedition. Select your science payload architecture, calculate astronomical distances, solar flux, and communications delay.

tasks.name: Primary Scientific Objective Selection
tasks.description: Designate the primary mission archetype (Orbiter, Stationary Lander, or Surface Rover) and primary science profile.

tasks.name: Mars Orbital Distance Range
tasks.description: Calculate Mars average orbital radius in Astronomical Units (AU) based on perihelion (1.381 AU) and aphelion (1.666 AU).

tasks.name: One-Way Light Time Delay
tasks.description: Compute the one-way radio communication latency from Earth to Mars at an opposition distance of 225 million kilometers (c = 299,792 km/s).

tasks.name: Martian Solar Irradiance at Mean Distance
tasks.description: Calculate the solar flux available at Mars mean orbit (1.524 AU) given 1 AU solar constant S0 = 1361 W/m².

tasks.name: Payload Structural Fraction Baseline
tasks.description: Establish target science payload mass allocation percentage relative to total dry mass (standard NASA guideline is 15-20%). Enter 18.0%.

levels.title: LEVEL 02: Engineering Challenge
levels.subtitle: Subsystems, Mass, Power & Delta-V
levels.description: Balance critical engineering budgets. Size the spacecraft bus, compute the electrical power balance, evaluate battery depth-of-discharge, and calculate propulsion Delta-V.

tasks.name: Spacecraft Total Dry Mass Budget
tasks.description: Sum the subsystem masses: Structure (320 kg), Avionics (85 kg), Power System (145 kg), Thermal (60 kg), Communications (40 kg), Science Payload (150 kg).

tasks.name: Solar Array Sizing for Mars Surface
tasks.description: Calculate required solar array surface area (m²) for a 350 W continuous daytime load, with 28% triple-junction cell efficiency, dust derating 0.80, and S = 586 W/m².

tasks.name: Battery Energy Storage for Martian Night
tasks.description: Determine battery storage capacity (Watt-hours) required to sustain 90 W night survival heaters over a 12.3-hour Martian night at 70% depth-of-discharge limit.

tasks.name: Cruise & Orbit Insertion Delta-V
tasks.description: Using Tsiolkovsky's Rocket Equation, calculate propellant mass required for Delta-V = 1600 m/s with Isp = 320 s (g0 = 9.80665 m/s²) and dry mass = 800 kg.

tasks.name: Radiative Equilibrium Thermal Rejection
tasks.description: Calculate radiator area (m²) needed to reject 400 W internal heat at 285 K (Stefan-Boltzmann sigma = 5.67e-8, emissivity = 0.90, deep space T_sink = 4 K).

levels.title: LEVEL 03: Launch Preparation
levels.subtitle: Launch Vehicle Integration & Orbital Dynamics
levels.description: Evaluate launch vehicle capacity curves, verify fairing envelope clearances, calculate characteristic launch energy (C3), and validate structural launch margins.

tasks.name: Characteristic Energy C3 Calculation
tasks.description: Calculate the hyperbolic excess velocity v_inf (km/s) from Earth required for standard Hohmann transfer injection with C3 = 16.5 km²/s² (v_inf = sqrt(C3)).

tasks.name: Earth-Mars Synodic Period
tasks.description: Compute the synodic recurrence period (days) between consecutive Earth-Mars launch windows (Earth period T1 = 365.25 days, Mars period T2 = 686.98 days).

tasks.name: Launch Vehicle Fairing Margin Verification
tasks.description: Given stowed spacecraft envelope diameter of 3.80 m inside a 5.00 m inner dynamic fairing envelope, calculate the diametrical clearance.

tasks.name: Launch Mass Margin Verification
tasks.description: Given launch vehicle TMI injection capacity of 2200 kg and total spacecraft wet mass of 1850 kg, calculate the launch mass reserve percentage.

levels.title: LEVEL 04: Journey to Mars
levels.subtitle: Interplanetary Cruise & Trajectory Correction
levels.description: Navigate the 200+ day interplanetary transit. Compute transfer orbital elements, plan Trajectory Correction Maneuvers (TCM), and monitor deep space communications links.

tasks.name: Hohmann Transfer Orbit Cruise Duration
tasks.description: Compute the one-way transit time (days) for a standard semi-elliptical Hohmann transfer orbit (semi-major axis a = (1.0 + 1.524)/2 = 1.262 AU, Sun mu = 1.327e11 km³/s²).

tasks.name: TCM-1 Midcourse Trajectory Correction Delta-V
tasks.description: Determine the required propellant mass to execute a 15.0 m/s TCM-1 trim burn for a 1750 kg cruise stage using hydrazine RCS (Isp = 220 s, g0 = 9.80665 m/s²).

tasks.name: Deep Space Network Signal Free-Space Path Loss
tasks.description: Calculate free-space path loss (FSPL in dB) at X-band (f = 8.4 GHz) for distance d = 2.0e8 km: FSPL = 20*log10(4*pi*d*f/c).
tasks.formula_hint: FSPL = 20 * log10(4 * pi * d * f / c)

tasks.name: Galactic Cosmic Radiation Dose Estimation
tasks.description: Calculate total ionizing radiation dose (mSv) absorbed by avionics over 260 days in deep space with 5 g/cm² aluminum shielding (daily dose rate = 1.8 mSv/day).

levels.title: LEVEL 05: Mars Exploration
levels.subtitle: Entry, Descent, Landing & Surface Science
levels.description: Execute the harrowing 'Seven Minutes of Terror' Entry, Descent, and Landing (EDL) sequence, verify surface stability, deploy science payloads, and achieve mission legacy.

tasks.name: Atmospheric Entry Velocity & Kinetic Energy
tasks.description: Calculate entry kinetic energy (GJ) for entry mass m = 1025 kg at hyperbolic atmospheric interface velocity v = 5.8 km/s (5800 m/s).

tasks.name: Supersonic Parachute Terminal Velocity
tasks.description: Compute terminal velocity (m/s) under 21.5 m diameter disk-gap-band parachute (Cd = 0.55) in thin Martian lower atmosphere (rho = 0.015 kg/m³) for 850 kg payload (Mars g = 3.72 m/s²).
tasks.formula_hint: v_t = sqrt((2 * m * g) / (rho * A * Cd)) where A = pi * (d/2)^2

tasks.name: Powered Descent Retro-Propulsion Burn Time
tasks.description: Calculate burn duration (seconds) needed to decelerate from 60 m/s to touchdown speed of 0.75 m/s at a steady net retro deceleration of 9.5 m/s².

tasks.name: Surface Traversing Mobility Energy Expenditure
tasks.description: Calculate Watt-hours consumed by six brushless DC drive motors traversing 120 meters on Jezero crater regolith (average power draw 180 W at 0.04 m/s traverse rate).

tasks.name: Total Mission Science Return Scoring
tasks.description: Verify cumulative science yield multiplier based on 4 instrument deployments, 15 core samples collected, and 100% telemetry link budget (Yield = 4 * 15 * 1.5).
